description: Create the traders API router structure
steps: Create src/prediction_data/api/traders/ directory
Create __init__.py, router.py, service.py, schemas.py files
Register traders router in api/main.py with prefix /api/v1/traders
Add 'traders' tag to router for OpenAPI grouping

description: Define Pydantic schemas for trader data
steps: Create TraderPosition schema: marketId (str), marketQuestion (str), outcomeId (str), outcomeName (str), quantity (float), avgCost (float), currentPrice (float), unrealizedPnl (float), realizedPnl (float)
Create TraderBase schema: address (str), username (str | None), firstSeen (str), totalPnl (float), realizedPnl (float), totalTrades (int), winCount (int), lossCount (int)
Create TraderResponse extending TraderBase with: id (str), smartScore (float | None), createdAt (str), updatedAt (str)
Create TraderDetailResponse extending TraderResponse with: positions (list[TraderPosition]), tradeCount (int), winRate (float)
Create TraderListResponse: items (list[TraderResponse]), total (int), page (int), limit (int)
Create SmartScoreResponse: address (str), smartScore (float), components (dict with accuracy, consistency, sizing, timing scores)
Create TraderFilters: search (str | None), sortBy (Literal['smartScore', 'totalPnl', 'totalTrades', 'winRate']), sortOrder (Literal['asc', 'desc']), limit (int = 50), offset (int = 0)

description: List traders with search and sorting
steps: Implement GET /traders endpoint
Accept query params: search (wallet address prefix or username), sortBy (smartScore, totalPnl, totalTrades), sortOrder (asc, desc), limit (default 50, max 500), offset
Query ClickHouse dim_wallet for trader metadata
Join with aggregated PnL data from wallet_pnl_daily
Calculate total trades from wallet_position_ledger
Apply search filter on address (ILIKE) or username
Apply sorting (default: totalPnl DESC)
Return TraderListResponse with pagination

description: Get smart trader scores and rankings
steps: Implement GET /traders/smart-scores endpoint
Accept query params: minScore (float), limit (default 100), timeWindow (7d, 30d, 90d, all)
Query or compute smart scores based on trading performance
Smart score components to consider: accuracy (win rate), consistency (regular profitable trades), sizing (appropriate position sizes), timing (entry/exit quality)
If smart scores not pre-computed, calculate from wallet_position_ledger data
Return list of SmartScoreResponse ordered by smartScore DESC
Implement GET /traders/{address} endpoint
Accept wallet address as path parameter (normalize to lowercase)
Query ClickHouse dim_wallet for trader metadata
Query wallet_position_state for current positions
Join positions with dim_market and dim_outcome for market details
Calculate unrealized PnL using current market prices
Query wallet_pnl_daily for historical PnL aggregates
Calculate win rate from wallet_position_ledger (closed positions with positive PnL)
Return TraderDetailResponse
Return 404 if trader not found
Implement GET /traders/{address}/trades endpoint
Accept wallet address as path parameter
Accept query params: limit (default 100, max 1000), offset, startDate, endDate, marketId (optional filter)
Query ClickHouse wallet_position_ledger for trader's transactions
Join with dim_market and dim_outcome for readable names
Include: timestamp, market question, outcome name, side (BUY/SELL), price, quantity, fees, realized PnL (if closing)
Order by timestamp DESC
Return list of TradeResponse with pagination
Create src/prediction_data/api/leaderboard/ directory or add to traders router
Create LeaderboardEntry schema: rank (int), traderAddress (str), pnl (float), tradeCount (int), winRate (float)
Create LeaderboardResponse: period (str), entries (list[LeaderboardEntry]), generatedAt (str)
Implement GET /leaderboard endpoint
Accept query params: period (Literal['1d', '7d', '30d', 'all']), limit (default 100, max 500)
Query ClickHouse wallet_pnl_daily aggregated by period
For '1d': filter to today's date
For '7d': filter to last 7 days, sum PnL
For '30d': filter to last 30 days, sum PnL
For 'all': aggregate all-time PnL
Calculate win rate and trade count for each trader
Order by PnL DESC, assign ranks
Return LeaderboardResponse
Create src/prediction_data/api/trades/ directory
Create router.py, service.py, schemas.py
Register trades router with prefix /api/v1/trades
Create SmartTradeResponse extending TradeResponse with: smartScore (float)
Implement GET /trades/smart endpoint
Accept query params: minScore (float, default 70), minAmount (float in USD), limit (default 50, max 200)
Query wallet_position_ledger for recent trades
Join with smart score data (pre-computed or from dim_wallet)
Filter to traders with smartScore >= minScore
Filter by trade USD value if minAmount specified
Order by timestamp DESC
Return list of SmartTradeResponse
Add GET /whales/trades endpoint (can be in trades router)
Create WhaleTradeResponse: same as TradeResponse plus totalWalletValue (float)
Accept query params: minAmount (USD, default 10000), limit (default 50)
Implement GET /whales/trades endpoint
Query wallet_position_ledger for recent large trades
Filter by USD value >= minAmount
Optionally filter to wallets with high total value or high PnL
Include trader's total portfolio value if available
Order by timestamp DESC
Return list of WhaleTradeResponse
Create src/prediction_data/api/smart_score.py with scoring functions
Define scoring components and weights:
- Accuracy (30%): win rate on closed positions
- Consistency (25%): standard deviation of returns, regular trading
- Sizing (25%): appropriate position sizes relative to portfolio
- Timing (20%): entry price vs final outcome, early exits
Implement compute_smart_score(wallet_address, lookback_days) function
Consider caching scores with TTL (recompute daily)
Add CLI command or scheduled job to pre-compute scores

description: Update frontend hooks for trader endpoints
steps: Update web/src/hooks/useTraders.ts to call /api/v1/traders
Update web/src/hooks/useTrader.ts to call /api/v1/traders/{address}
Update web/src/hooks/useTraderTrades.ts to call /api/v1/traders/{address}/trades
Create useLeaderboard.ts hook for /api/v1/leaderboard
Create useSmartTrades.ts hook for /api/v1/trades/smart
Remove Prisma-based trader data fetching
Update React Query cache keys

description: Regenerate OpenAPI spec with trader endpoints
steps: Run python scripts/export_openapi.py
Verify all trader, leaderboard, and trade endpoints are documented
Run npm run generate-api in web/
Verify TypeScript types for trader-related schemas
